periods.description: Postwar bandit group formed from fallen soldiers who stole Drag-Rides and a horn used to manipulate Abysses. They attack weak frontier villages and attempt to seize Ariel to access ruins power.
periods.history: Grew during postwar confusion by disguising raids as Abyss attacks.
periods.goals: Capture Ariel, open ruins, obtain stronger power and expand criminal gains.
periods.structure: Unnamed leader with former soldiers, stolen Drag-Rides, hidden troops and Abysses controlled by horn.
periods.headquarters: mobile / hidden camps near Crossfield plains
